# Re-Bath

> > Re-Bath is America's leading bathroom remodeling company, specializing in fast 3-5 day renovations, ADA-compliant accessible bathrooms, and walk-in tub installations with 40+ years of experience.

Re-Bath operates through a nationwide network of franchise locations offering comprehensive bathroom remodeling services including full renovations, shower updates, tub-to-shower conversions, and accessible bathroom solutions. The company partners with HGTV's Jenny and Dave Marrs for design inspiration and provides free in-home consultations.

## Key Topics

- Bathroom Remodeling
- ADA-Compliant Accessible Bathrooms
- Walk-In Tubs
